key_learnings: 1. habit_list is the winning format: 4,318 avg views, 5.20% engagement across 28 posts. Use it for 50%+ of content.
2. Activities & Play is the winning pillar: 226% of avg views. Outdoor activities alone hit 57,600 views.
3. Activities drive saves (avg 73 saves vs 5.5 for advice). Saves = high intent = growth signal.
4. Hooks MUST be specific outcomes, not generic. 'that water table hack got me 20 minutes' > 'water play ideas'.
5. Hashtag-only hooks fail: bottom performers averaged 298 views vs 3,470 account avg.
6. boring_habits format underperforms: 729 avg views, 2.62% engagement. Pause or rethink.
7. Proven visuals: iPhone-authentic, natural lighting, warm golden palette, wide outdoor shots.
9. Retire: screen time, picky eater strategies, products & gear — all <500 avg views.
10. Specificity wins: age-specific + situation-specific topics (e.g. '3 month old who can't sit yet') outperform generic.

sensory_and_outdoor_activities.rationale: Top pillar — 4,606 avg views, 104 avg saves

content_angle: Actionable activities over advice — activities avg 73 saves vs advice avg 5.5 saves
